data.content: Find the 10 most frequent multiple risk drivers

args.query: List the 10 most frequent combinations of substances that act as mixture risk drivers (i.e., multiple substances jointly identified as IS_DRIVER at the same site and time point). For each combination, provide the substances involved and the number of occurrences.

data.content:
No data was found for the following cypher: MATCH (substance:Substance)-[d:IS_DRIVER]->(site:Site)
WITH site.name AS site_name, d.time_point AS time, d.species AS species, collect(DISTINCT substance.Name) AS substance_set
WHERE size(substance_set) > 1  // Only consider cases with multiple drivers
WITH apoc.coll.sort(substance_set) AS sorted_set
WITH sorted_set, count(*) AS frequency
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 10
RETURN sorted_set AS Substances, frequency AS Occurrences
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
No data was found for the 10 most frequent combinations of substances acting as multiple (mixture) risk drivers at the same site and time point. This means that, based on the available data, there are either no recorded instances of multiple substances jointly identified as risk drivers, or such combinations are not present in the dataset.
